task: W200-A3: TACSTD2 in malignant cells, MPR vs non-MPR
reasons: The only expression file (GSE243013_NSCLC_immune_scRNA_counts.mtx.gz) is 6.6 GB gzipped, exceeding the 2 GB processed-data budget.

The atlas is CD45+/immune-only: cell metadata contains exclusively T/NK, B and Myeloid cells, with zero epithelial or malignant cells, so malignant-cell TACSTD2 cannot be measured from this dataset at any size.
